resources.string:
Nika is a screen reader for Android.

What's new in this version:
• Quick settings with gestures: next/previous setting and value (keyboard echo, punctuation, emoji).
• Volume keys: slider in focus, cursor in a field, no volume panel.
• The backup is now a zip, and you choose what to restore.
• The notification history can be cleared one entry at a time; progress out of focus is spoken; the words collapsed, button and heading are no longer said in settings.
Write to the developer in Telegram: report a problem or suggest an idea
